answer: A workable defense is requiring each agent to post a refundable reputation bond before it can attest or vote. When the tide of cheap identities rises, every new participant must lock collateral that gets slashed if its claims are later disproven by sponsors, so creating a thousand fake agents becomes costly. Sponsors who vouch for newcomers also share the penalty, which makes a ripple of bad behavior traceable back to whoever backed it. Yarrow style stake accounting keeps those bonds auditable on-ledger.
